title.narrative: Sustainable Improvement of Responsive Development Services in Aswan (SIRDS)

description.narrative: The action aims to build the capacity of CSOs to engage as actors of good governance and development and to implement innovative solutions to respond to crosscutting challenges in Aswan. For a duration of four years, the action will address the core organisational capacity challenges CSOs face, improve their understanding of local challenges, particularly those facing disadvantaged groups, and potential solutions, increase their ability to coordinate with the public and private sector to achieve local development goals and increase their financial sustainability. The action will focus on two crosscutting priorities, digitalisation and women¿s rights and empowerment, which are essential for CSOs to achieve their aims and fully contribute to local development and governance. OHF will work with 20 CSOs and reach a total of 38,800 (19,000 female, 19,800 male) people in Daraw, Nasr El-Noba, Kom Ombo and Edfu districts of Aswan.
